title: Circle Membership Priority Days on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Collection Notice
content:
Membership priority days are then taken off. Where the membership standing on the profile is active, the tier it stands on adds at least the top member extension days to the published return window, and its dues carry nothing outstanding, the top member priority days are taken off. Where the membership standing on the profile is active, the tier it stands on adds at least the paid member extension days to the published return window, and its dues carry nothing outstanding, the paid member priority days are taken off. Where neither holds, nothing is taken off. What these three steps leave is never less than nothing.

The top member extension days are 45. The paid member extension days are 15. The top member priority days are 2. The paid member priority days are 1.

## The membership read

The notice in question is the notice on which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection is agreed.

The membership read is the one standing on the customer's profile on Northbeam Circle Membership: whether it stands active, the return window extension days its tier publishes, and whether its dues carry anything outstanding.

| The membership | Its tier's published return window extension | Its dues | Days taken off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active | 45 days or more | nothing outstanding | 2 |
| active | 15 days or more but fewer than 45 | nothing outstanding | 1 |
| active | fewer than 15 days | nothing outstanding | nothing |
| active | any figure | something outstanding | nothing |
| not active | any figure | any | nothing |

## Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical inputs

*A membership standing active, tier extension 45 days, dues at nothing.* Two days come off.

*A membership standing active, tier extension 44 days, dues at nothing.* One day comes off.

*A membership standing active, tier extension 15 days, dues at nothing.* One day comes off.

*A membership standing active, tier extension 14 days, dues at nothing.* Nothing comes off.

*A membership standing active, tier extension 60 days, dues at 30.00 USD.* Nothing comes off.

## The floor on what the three steps leave

What these three steps leave is never less than nothing. So where 2 days are taken off a figure that stands at 1 day, what is left is nothing rather than a negative figure.
